weather_summary: Sunnyvale, Fremont, and San Jose look mostly sunny and manageable for late August, generally mid-70s to low/mid-80s depending on microclimate. Morning outdoor plans are reasonable; keep water, hats, and a quick indoor backup for warmer San Jose festival/circus options.

events.title: Sunnyvale Farmers' Market morning snack walk
events.label: Closest market
events.place: Downtown Sunnyvale / Murphy Avenue, Sunnyvale
events.food: Market fruit, pastries, coffee, prepared foods, and downtown lunch nearby
events.why: The lowest-friction Saturday plan from Sunnyvale: flexible, snack-heavy, strollerable, and easy to leave before nap.

events.title: Family Movie: The Good Dinosaur
events.label: Sunday indoor
events.place: Sunnyvale Public Library, Sunnyvale
events.food: Downtown Sunnyvale snacks or early dinner nearby
events.why: A simple, free, air-conditioned Sunday option with a toddler-recognizable movie and minimal drive friction.

events.title: Environmental Education Center Open House
events.label: Nature hands-on
events.place: McClellan Ranch Preserve, Cupertino
events.food: Pack snacks; Cupertino cafes and Main Street are nearby after
events.why: Animal ambassadors, preserve staff, local ecology, and hands-on nature activities make this one of the best free toddler-friendly outings this weekend.

events.title: Children's Discovery Museum Toddler Storytime + Dino Shadows
events.label: Museum backup
events.time: Sat or Sun, museum hours; Toddler Storytime 11:30 AM
events.place: Children's Discovery Museum of San Jose
events.food: Downtown San Jose lunch and snack options nearby
events.why: Purpose-built for toddlers, weather-proof, and the Dino Shadows exhibit runs through August with toddler storytime Wednesday through Sunday.
events.sourceName: Children's Discovery Museum of San Jose

events.title: San Jose Public Library Music and Movement
events.label: Free storytime
events.place: Santa Teresa Branch Library, San Jose
events.food: Pick up snacks or lunch nearby after the short program
events.why: A short, structured early-literacy music program for ages 0-5. Good when the family wants a clean indoor win without committing the whole day.

events.title: Mountain View Farmers Market
events.label: Sunday market
events.place: Downtown Mountain View Caltrain Station parking lot
events.food: 70+ growers and vendors plus Castro Street cafes and lunch nearby
events.why: Reliable Sunday food walk with strong stroller logistics, transit access, and flexible timing for nap windows.

events.title: Palo Alto Junior Museum & Zoo
events.label: Animals + play
events.time: Sat or Sun morning; reserve admission
events.place: Palo Alto Junior Museum & Zoo, Palo Alto
events.cost: Paid admission; children under 12 months free
events.food: Town & Country, California Ave, or picnic at Rinconada Park
events.why: Toddler-scale animals and hands-on exhibits, with enough indoor/outdoor mix to adapt to the microclimate.

events.title: Santa Clara Farmers Market
events.label: Saturday market
events.place: Jackson Street and Homestead Road, Santa Clara
events.food: Produce, prepared foods, juice, coffee, and Santa Clara lunch nearby
events.why: Close, simple, and snack-friendly with a clean morning window and an easy exit before nap.

events.title: Campbell Farmers Market
events.label: Brunch market
events.place: Downtown Campbell
events.food: Market snacks, bakeries, coffee, and downtown Campbell brunch
events.why: One of the better food-forward South Bay market walks, with compact downtown stroller flow and lots of snack choices.

events.title: California Avenue Farmers Market
events.label: Palo Alto snacks
events.place: California Avenue, Palo Alto
events.food: Market produce, baked goods, coffee, and California Ave restaurants
events.why: A good northbound market if you want a food walk plus Palo Alto errands, with easy snack pacing for toddlers.

events.title: Baer Blacksmith Shop Demonstrations
events.label: Short demo
events.time: Sat, Aug 29; check city listing for demo hours
events.place: McClellan Ranch Preserve, Cupertino
events.food: Pack snacks; Cupertino lunch nearby
events.why: Interesting old-Cupertino history and visual craft demo. Best paired with the Environmental Education Center, and best kept short for toddlers.

events.title: Silicon Valley Pride Festival & Parade
events.label: Big festival
events.time: Sat-Sun, Aug 29-30; Sunday gates listed at 11:30 AM
events.place: Plaza de Cesar Chavez / Plaza Park, San Jose
events.cost: Ticketed festival; verify parade access and family garden details
events.food: Festival food vendors and downtown San Jose restaurants
events.why: A major community weekend with food vendors, family-friendly activities, and a family garden, but crowd/noise/parking make it a deliberate outing rather than an easy toddler default.

events.title: Chicano Soul Fest
events.label: Culture + food
events.place: History Park, San Jose
events.food: Festival food vendors and nearby San Jose options
events.why: A rich cultural festival with music, art, lowriders, vendors, and food. Strong for families who can handle crowds and amplified music.

events.title: Caballero Circus San Jose
events.label: Evening show
events.time: Sat, Aug 29, 7:00 PM; circus run listed Aug 7-31
events.place: Emma Prusch Farm Park, San Jose
events.food: San Jose food nearby; plan dinner before show
events.why: All-ages circus can be memorable, but the listed 7 PM showtime is rough for toddler bedtime. Consider only if evening stamina is good.

events.title: Happy Hollow Park & Zoo morning visit
events.label: Animal fallback
events.place: Happy Hollow Park & Zoo, San Jose
events.food: Onsite snacks plus nearby Kelley Park / San Jose food
events.why: Reliable toddler attraction with animals and play areas; go early while San Jose is cooler.

events.title: Lowe's Kids Workshop: MrBeast Swarm Twister
events.label: Older preschool
events.place: Lowe's stores, including Sunnyvale-area locations when available
events.cost: Workshop registration may be free or paid depending on location; verify before registering
events.food: Pair with nearby coffee or lunch after a short build
events.why: Good indoor hands-on option for older preschoolers; less ideal for younger toddlers because tools and small parts may need heavy adult help.

events.title: SJPL Haopinaka Hawaiian Music and Dance
events.label: Sunday music
events.place: Edenvale Branch Library, San Jose
events.food: Plan snacks before or after; branch-area food varies
events.why: A free interactive Hawaiian music and dance program. Afternoon timing is less nap-safe, but it is a solid indoor cultural option.

events.title: Que Viva exhibit at King Library
events.label: Quiet indoor
events.place: Dr. Martin Luther King Jr. Library, San Jose
events.food: Downtown San Jose cafes and restaurants nearby
events.why: A short culture stop about Mexican music and dance. Better as a paired downtown errand than a standalone toddler adventure.

events.title: Levitt on Location at Fridays at the Lake
events.label: Friday kickoff
events.place: Lake Cunningham, San Jose
events.food: Picnic or nearby San Jose food before/after
events.why: Free family-friendly live music if Friday evening works, but bedtime and sound level make it a lower-ranked toddler option.
